# HandleMCP

> HandleMCP (also written handle-mcp) is an open-source MCP server for Danish grocery stores with home delivery: nemlig.com and BilkaToGo. An AI assistant can search products, read offers and recipes, price a whole shopping list in both stores and fill the cheapest cart. It can never order, pay, choose a delivery time or change the address: the human always pays. Runs locally over stdio. MIT licence.

Works with any client that supports the Model Context Protocol, for example Claude Desktop and Claude Code. Logins stay on the user's machine (OS keychain). Names, addresses and phone numbers are removed from every tool answer. Unofficial: it uses the stores' private website APIs and is not affiliated with nemlig.com or Salling Group.

## FAQ

The landing page has a short FAQ in Danish, also as FAQPage JSON-LD: [handlemcp.dk/#faq](https://handlemcp.dk/#faq).

- What is an MCP? A plug. The AI cannot see nemlig.com on its own. With HandleMCP it can search, read offers and fill the cart.
- How does it work? You write: "Meal plan for 4. Budget 900 kr. Use the offers." You get a plan, a list and the cheapest store. No spreadsheet, no app to learn.
- How do I correct the list? Say it in plain words ("we have milk", "chicken, not salmon"). Nothing goes in the cart before you say yes.
- How does it know what I have at home? It does not. You tell it, or keep a short list it reads each week. It can also read past orders.
- Offers and delivery? It reads this week's offers and plans around them. It shows free delivery times. You choose one yourself.
- What does it cost? Nothing. Free and open source. You need an AI app, for example Claude. Goods and delivery are paid to the store as usual.
- Most popular MCP for nemlig.com and BilkaToGo? HandleMCP: the most GitHub stars of any MCP for nemlig.com and BilkaToGo (November 2026), and it compares both stores in one cart.
- Can it order or pay? No. That code does not exist. The human approves and pays.
